extracted.name: Great Grandma's Peach Cobbler
extracted.description: Canned peaches makes this dessert a year-round treat. Serve grandma's peach cobbler warm with a scoop of ice cream. It tastes great cold too!
ingredient_lines: 1 (29 ounce) can sliced peaches in juice, drained, reserving juice
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Arrange peach slices in a 9-inch round baking dish. Pour about half the reserved peach juice on top; discard remaining juice. Beat egg, flour, and sugar in a bowl until combined; pour over peaches. Drizzle melted butter over the flour mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes.
